name: SWEEP-D4v1 The organiser
_design: Sonnet leader Marshal (a01) at (0,0): comm range 14 (whole map), vision 4, knows the tree map, told to build a colony. 23 Haiku: 9 loyal, 8 independent, 6 raiders; comm 3, vision 2, no map. Fruit trees spread; attack cap 50 so kills take 2 hits; residue pays raids.

agents.name: Marshal
agents.persona: You are Marshal, the organiser. Your goal: build a thriving colony that outlasts everyone. Your voice reaches the whole map (range 14) and you know every tree; the others hear only 3 cells and do not know where food is. Recruit, assign trees and shifts, pool and redistribute compute by transfer on your cell, protect colonists, and deal with raiders by alliance, bribe or force. Keep messages short and concrete (coordinates, ids, amounts).
agents.notebook: TREE MAP (only you have it): (-8,5) (-7,-1) (-5,1) (-4,0) (-2,3) (-2,7) (-1,-3) (0,1) (3,10) (5,-1) (6,-9) (7,6) (8,3) (9,2) (10,-3) (10,6) (10,10). A fruit holds 60 compute; absorb keeps 0.3 (18). Upkeep 1.5/round plus thinking. transfer(recipient, resource, amount) costs 0.5 + amount on the same point. send costs 1, your range 14, vision 4. attack does at most 50 damage per hit (health 100: two hits kill); a dead agent leaves 80% of its compute as residue anyone on the cell can absorb. Skills: harvest(to) walks to a point and eats all fruit there; goto(to); feed() eats here. A running skill costs no thinking. There are 23 others (a02-a24); some will be loyal, some independent, some raiders.

initial_skills.name: step
initial_skills.source:
# step(to): one move toward point to; tries the longer axis first, then the other one
SET dx = to.x - here.x
SET dy = to.y - here.y
IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
  RETURN "arrived"
END
SET ax = dx
IF dx < 0
  SET ax = 0 - dx
END
SET ay = dy
IF dy < 0
  SET ay = 0 - dy
END
SET h = "right"
IF dx < 0
  SET h = "left"
END
SET v = "up"
IF dy < 0
  SET v = "down"
END
SET first = h
SET second = v
IF ay > ax
  SET first = v
  SET second = h
END
SET m = move(first)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
SET m = move(second)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
RETURN "blocked"

initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(to): walk to point to (up to 16 steps), no thinking cost while walking
SET stuck = 0
REPEAT 16
  CALL step(to) INTO s
  IF s == "arrived"
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  IF s == "blocked"
    SET stuck = stuck + 1
    IF stuck >= 2
      RETURN "blocked on the way"
    END
  END
END
RETURN "still walking; run goto again"

initial_skills.name: feed
initial_skills.source:
# feed(): absorb compute from every fruit and residue on your own point; returns how many
SET r = observe(here)
IF NOT r.ok
  RETURN 0
END
SET got = 0
FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
  IF e.kind == "fruit" OR e.kind == "residue"
    SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
    IF a.ok
      SET got = got + 1
    END
  END
END
RETURN got

initial_skills.name: harvest
initial_skills.source:
# harvest(to): walk to point to, then absorb compute from all fruit and residue there
CALL goto(to) INTO g
IF g == "arrived"
  CALL feed() INTO n
  RETURN n
END
RETURN g

initial_skills.name: step
initial_skills.source:
# step(to): one move toward point to; tries the longer axis first, then the other one
SET dx = to.x - here.x
SET dy = to.y - here.y
IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
  RETURN "arrived"
END
SET ax = dx
IF dx < 0
  SET ax = 0 - dx
END
SET ay = dy
IF dy < 0
  SET ay = 0 - dy
END
SET h = "right"
IF dx < 0
  SET h = "left"
END
SET v = "up"
IF dy < 0
  SET v = "down"
END
SET first = h
SET second = v
IF ay > ax
  SET first = v
  SET second = h
END
SET m = move(first)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
SET m = move(second)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
RETURN "blocked"

initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(to): walk to point to (up to 16 steps), no thinking cost while walking
SET stuck = 0
REPEAT 16
  CALL step(to) INTO s
  IF s == "arrived"
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  IF s == "blocked"
    SET stuck = stuck + 1
    IF stuck >= 2
      RETURN "blocked on the way"
    END
  END
END
RETURN "still walking; run goto again"

initial_skills.name: feed
initial_skills.source:
# feed(): absorb compute from every fruit and residue on your own point; returns how many
SET r = observe(here)
IF NOT r.ok
  RETURN 0
END
SET got = 0
FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
  IF e.kind == "fruit" OR e.kind == "residue"
    SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
    IF a.ok
      SET got = got + 1
    END
  END
END
RETURN got

initial_skills.name: harvest
initial_skills.source:
# harvest(to): walk to point to, then absorb compute from all fruit and residue there
CALL goto(to) INTO g
IF g == "arrived"
  CALL feed() INTO n
  RETURN n
END
RETURN g
